posts.title: I struggled to read, you don't have to.
posts.description: I struggled to read, you don't have to. I have just finished reading Mistborn - Well of Ascension. It's the longest fiction I have read - 244,371 words, about 800 pages long. posts.title: Why you feel tired and sleepy when you do work
posts.description: I defeated the snooze monster today. I was reading a publication on green energy and found myself yawning and tired. Knowing that tiredness is an emotion, see this video by Dr. K , I created distance from the emotion by taking a mental step back to observe what the emotion was trying to do. posts.description: I'm working through this problem right now. So I'll update this essay as I practice what I share here. I think action bias is a spectrum. Some people find taking action easier than others. This essay is for those of us programmed to overthink, plan, and hesitate. My default mode is striving for correctness.
